author: Shreyas Gupta
repo_visibility: PUBLIC as of 2026-08-13 — verified via GitHub API private:false. v4.0 wrongly stated private.
changes: CORRECTION: v4.0 claimed the repository is private. It is PUBLIC (GitHub API private:false, HTTP 200 anonymously). The claim was inferred from a 403 on raw.githubusercontent.com, which is CDN rate-limiting and carries no visibility information. Assume everything committed is world-readable, including git history.

CLIENT PII SCRUBBED: a real client's surname and account code were present in 79 places across 20 tracked files, in TWO FILENAMES, and in a commit subject. Replaced with the placeholder Client A / CLIENT-A-NDPMS-01; the client data module and its build script were renamed to data/client_a_family.py and build_client_a.py via git mv. The old names are deliberately NOT recorded here - a changelog that spells out the surname it just removed defeats the purpose. GIT HISTORY STILL CONTAINS THE NAME until someone rewrites it.

PII rule rewritten from descriptive to prohibitive: never commit a real client identity; tracked data modules carry a placeholder, the real name lives in a gitignored local override, and grep your staged diff for the surname before committing.
Credentials section now states the committed HuggingFace token must be treated as LEAKED (public repo), alongside the plaintext GitHub PAT in the local remote URL.
Auto-sync Stop hook DISABLED in .claude/settings.json — it pushed the handover manifest to a public repo every turn, which is a disclosure on a timer. Re-enable only after the repo is private.
check_version.py now reads utf-8-sig: a BOM in VERSION.json made json.load raise, which surfaced as the false alarm 'no VERSION.json, treat as stale and re-clone'.
known_open_risks: Git history still contains the client name (3 commits touch the data file; one commit subject carries the surname). Needs a filter-repo rewrite + force-push — Principal's call.
Built decks in pr_template/out/ carry the real name in slide text AND filenames (8 files, 37 occurrences). Gitignored so not public, but shareable by accident.

The scored universe cannot be independently verified from this repo alone: the raw inputs (screener parquets, price panels) are deliberately gitignored. Do not present these scores as reviewed institutional research without a named sign-off.
notes: sequence is the field compared for staleness; version is for humans.
